generalMembersNote: Committee roles (registered nurse, physician, workplace, etc.) to be added once confirmed. Elections are held every three years, open to all active members.
missionPara1: MHPU exists to make sure no health professional in the Maldives faces an unsafe workplace, an unfair dispute, or a stalled career alone. We represent members in individual cases, bargain collectively on pay and conditions, and campaign publicly for safer, better-resourced health services — from Male' hospitals to the smallest island health centre.
heroHeadline: Built by healthcare workers, for healthcare workers.

history.text: Founded by a small group of laboratory technologists with a vision to unite healthcare workers and advance their rights, welfare, and professional interests.
Affiliation with Public Services International (PSI) - global union federation of workers in public services
Launch of Thaareeheh Hoadhan Campaign and Support Staff Matter Campaign
Launch of Over Time Pay Issue campaign

heroLede: Maldives Health Professionals Union is the labour federation representing and advocating for the rights, welfare, and professional interests of both local and expatriate healthcare workers, including professional and support cadres, working across the Maldives.
guides: Independence — Maintaining independent union decision-making, free from employer or political influence.
Solidarity — Standing together to protect the rights, dignity, and welfare of all healthcare workers, with every member treated equally regardless of role, profession, nationality, or island.
Accountability — Ensuring union leadership is elected by the members and remains transparent, responsible, and accountable to them.
ctaText: Members can stand for regional representative roles, join a bargaining committee, or help organise in their workplace.
